title: Prompt Library — Preserve & Render Rich Text Color Formatting

requirements.summary: Preserve per-prompt text color markup when sanitizing and saving rich-text content so saved prompts retain their selected colors.
acceptanceCriteria: In the “Add Prompt” dialog, applying a non-black text color and clicking Save results in the saved prompt content retaining that color when the prompt is re-opened for editing.
After saving, the prompt content retains the selected text colors when rendered in List view and in the Preview dialog.
Color formatting is preserved across a page refresh and after data is reloaded from the backend (i.e., the HTML stored for the prompt still contains the necessary color markup).

file_operations.description: Update HTML sanitization to preserve/normalize text color markup on save: explicitly support browser-generated <font color="..."> by converting it to an allowed element (e.g., span) while retaining its color, and preserve equivalent inline color styles (style="color: ...") on allowed formatting tags without allowing unsafe styles. Ensure normalization results in stable color markup being kept in the sanitized HTML string.

Ensure the Save flow continues to sanitize using the updated sanitizer and that the stored/sent prompt content uses the normalized, color-preserving HTML output (no additional transformations that would drop color).

requirements.summary: Render persisted per-prompt text colors consistently across all prompt rendering paths (including search-filtered results) without stripping colors during sanitization.
acceptanceCriteria: When a prompt is found via the search input, its displayed content retains the saved text colors (no regression to all-black text).
No rendering path (e.g., list/grid/table/preview) strips saved text colors while still sanitizing unsafe HTML.

file_operations.description: Confirm all rendered HTML prompt content uses the updated sanitizeHtml behavior so color markup remains intact while unsafe HTML is still removed (single consistent rendering sanitizer).

Update the grid view preview to render prompt content via the shared PromptContent (sanitized HTML rendering) rather than converting to plain text, so persisted text colors are visible in grid cards as well as in search-filtered results when grid view is active.
